default_rationale.obpi-0.0.59-05-hash-compare-non-mutation: Hash comparison via Path.read_bytes() before/after running an audit is a legitimate BEHAVIOR test of the audit's non-mutation invariant — assertion is on hash equality, not file content. Scanner false-positive. (OBPI-0.0.59-05, file test_promoted_advisory_audits.py)
default_rationale.obpi-0.0.59-05-tempdir-manifest-idempote: Test exercises regenerate_distribution_baseline() and asserts on structural equality of the produced manifest across two runs (idempotence invariant). read_text reads a tempdir-scoped manifest produced by the regenerator under test — production-code behavior is tested, not file content. Scanner false-positive. (OBPI-0.0.59-05, file test_distribution_audit.py)
default_rationale.obpi-0.0.59-05-tempdir-ledger-emission: Test exercises regenerate_distribution_baseline() and asserts that a distribution_baseline_regenerated event is appended to the tempdir ledger. read_text reads a tempdir-scoped ledger.jsonl produced by the regenerator under test — ledger emission BEHAVIOR is tested, not file content. Scanner false-positive. (OBPI-0.0.59-05, file test_distribution_audit.py)
default_rationale.ghi-1318-rule-channel-table-fence: TestAdvancesIsNotCountedAsAChannel.test_channel_table_excludes_advances reads .gzkit/rules/task-discovery.md and asserts its channel table carries no @advances row: a doc-consistency fence over canon that the rule itself names as its witness (GHI #1318). It claims no REQ (no @covers), no gz validate scope covers it to fold into, and converting it to injected text would stop it witnessing the real rule.
default_rationale.ghi-1318-rule-channel-count-fence: TestAdvancesIsNotCountedAsAChannel.test_invariant_count_matches_channel_table reads .gzkit/rules/task-discovery.md and asserts the invariant's channel count equals the channel table's rows, the second half of the same GHI #1318 fence; no @covers, no validator scope to fold into, and injected text would stop it witnessing the real rule.
default_rationale.rp12-malformed-tag-row-ledger-injection: test_a_malformed_tag_row_refuses_the_accept_and_names_its_void opens the temp project's ledger only to append a malformed tag_hung row (state injection), then asserts the accept verb's exit 3 and its named recovery (gz ledger correct): behavior of the verb, not file content. Scanner false-positive. (RP-12 ruling 141)
default_rationale.ro9-sealed-script-formatter-output: test_a_named_sealed_script_survives_the_formatter_under_that_config reads tempdir files that ruff format produced under the repository's exclude config and asserts which were reformatted: behavior of the formatter configuration, not file content. Scanner false-positive. (RO-9 tranche 4)
